planets.name: Kepler-445 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-445 with a 8.15-day year, found in 2015.

text.card: Kepler-445 d was found in 2015 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around Kepler-445. Its orbit and size follow Muirhead et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
